summary: Enqueue process.nextTick callbacks on Node's dedicated next-tick queue rather than the Promise/V8 microtask queue.

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.timing: after current JavaScript operation completes and before event loop continues
semantics.arguments: extra arguments are passed to callback

caveats: process.nextTick is legacy in current Node documentation; queueMicrotask is preferred for portable deferral.
Do not lower to JsMicrotaskQueue.Enqueue because Node gives nextTick its own queue and ordering.
